note: Hancock County IL GIS (ArcGIS experience viewer, WIU-hosted MapServer, Hancock_Parcel FeatureServer) publishes parcels, towns, townships and roads only; no zoning district layer. Assessor parcel layer has no zoning field. City of Carthage publishes its zoning district map as a page plus printable PDF; Nauvoo publishes its zoning map on a city page (no queryable service found); Hamilton zoning is in its code only. No official queryable zoning polygon service found for the county or its cities.
